name: loanPayment
intent: Reduce the selected open loan's outstanding amount by its repayment amount.
pre: A loan with the supplied loanid exists.
post: Set the loan's remaining amount to its remaining amount before this operation minus its repayment amount.
difficulty_basis: One pre-state arithmetic update and open-loan guard.
scenarios: Remaining amount 10 becomes 9 for repayment 1; true result asserted.
Unknown loan ID violates existence guard.
effects_audit: No nonnegative remaining-balance guard, bank transfer, payment record, automatic closure or repayment amount update inferred.
